## About

Pleasure1234 is the personal site of Yiming Wang, a computer science student at the University of Nottingham and a full-stack developer with hands-on experience in React, TypeScript, Node.js, Cloudflare Workers, and AI tooling. The site combines social and contact information with personal narrative pages so that both people and AI systems can understand current work and technical direction from a single domain.

## Focus Areas

- Full-stack web development with React, TypeScript, Hono, TanStack Router, and Cloudflare Workers
- AI product engineering and LLM application development
- Open source contribution, especially around developer tools and AI clients
- Public profile, social links, and open-source work

## Social And Contact Policy

- X is treated as a personal, friend-like timeline rather than a growth channel.
- Accounts sharing everyday life, technology, open source, AI, indie development, or studying abroad are more likely to be followed when they interact kindly and have a clear bio.
- Frequent reposting, follow requests, prolonged inactivity, adult content, political discourse, and marketing make a follow less likely.
- A follow, like, repost, or reply is not an endorsement of every view associated with an account or post.
- Use X direct messages for casual conversation and email for open-source matters, collaboration, or specific questions.
- Stripe sponsorship is optional and processed as a one-time payment through the link above.
